findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (1 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 206 characters per line.
The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 57.6px (4vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The margins differ: 112px on the left, 128px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "LEKKI LAND & HOUSES EXPERT · KL" → 6 lines (7 words, 23px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 2 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Chat with Yemisi", "View estates"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
